body_text:
Suppose $f$ is holomorphic on a punctured neighborhood of
$z_0$. The point is a removable singularity if $f$ extends
holomorphically across $z_0$, a pole of order $m$ if its
Laurent principal part has terms through $(z-z_0)^{-m}$ and no
lower power, and an essential singularity if infinitely many
negative-power coefficients are nonzero. These three cases are
mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
